messages:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm publishing the release notes draft for the inference rollout. Target deploy 2024-09-15 16:30 UTC. Please review ops/rollback bits. Link: https://docs.internal/rn/inference-v2
Ravi: Reviewing now. Can we confirm the pinned model for canary?
Maya: Yes: pin model inference-api:v2.4.0-alpha -> stable v2.4.1 after canary. Canary config: 10% traffic, 6 hour window.
Nina: Sounds good. Suggest making the rollback criteria explicit in RN. I'll propose thresholds.
Ravi: Proposed thresholds: sustained 5xx rate >=4% for 10m OR sustained p99 latency degradation >1.5x baseline for 3 consecutive 5m buckets triggers rollback. Also add manual rollback if error spike correlates to model outputs.
Maya: Add that and include who executes rollback (on-call). Assign rollback owner: Paul.
Paul: I can be rollback owner for the first 8 hours post-deploy. Rollback command:
```
# rollback to last stable
infractl deploy rollback --service=inference --target-tag=v2.3.9 --reason="canary-alert"
```
Maya: Please paste this exact command in RN ops snippet. Also include link to runbook: https://runbooks.internal/rollback-inference
deploybot: Scheduled deploy: 2024-09-15T16:30:00Z. Canary: 10% traffic for 6h. Fallback: rollback to v2.3.9.
Nina: Two more notes: (1) internal announce at T-15m in #eng-releases and #oncall, (2) customer-facing notes at T+3h only if canary passes. Add embargo flag in RN.
Ravi: Microcopy for PMs: "No user-facing feature changes. Expect throughput improvements on long responses." Suggest rewording to quantify: "Throughput improvements ~8-12% for responses >512 tokens."
Maya: Good — include the quant. Also include telemetry tag for post-deploy eval: tag=rn-inference-v2.4.0-alpha. Nina, can you add the eval prompt set?
Nina: Will do. Dropping the snippet here when ready.
Paul: Note on rollback: If rollback is triggered, I'll open an incident channel and notify infra lead. Also I'll run the post-rollback verification checklist from the runbook.
Maya: Ok final checklist: RN updated with rollback command, thresholds, owners, runbook link, internal announce schedule (T-15m), customer announce (T+3h post-success), telemetry tag, and canary config. Anyone object to me sending the internal announce 15m before?
Ravi: No objections. Go ahead. I'll monitor latency dashboards.
Nina: I'll paste the eval prompt set in the doc in ~12m and then send final note.
deploybot: Reminder: scheduled in 10m for thread 1766005555.
Maya: Thanks all — sending internal preflight in 12m. Tagging this thread for RN archive. :white_check_mark:
